src: hotā yakṣad indraṃ harivāṁ ity anusavanaṃ praiṣo yathāsamāmnātam
tgt: hotā yakṣadindraṃ harivāṁ ityādiko 'nusavanaṃ savanīyapurolāśānāṃ praiṣaḥ / anusavanamiti prasaṅgamupajīvatā lāghavārthamihaivoktaṃ / taittirīyāṇāmitarayorapi savanayoḥ payasyāsti / tadupalakṣaṇapratiṣedhārthaṃ yathāsamāmnātavacanam /

savanīyahaviḥpraiṣasya yathāsavanamabhidadhatprayogaṃ karoti / vakṣyatyutsargiṇāmayane (13.20) yaddevato vā savanīyaḥ syāt tatra paśutantre havīṃṣyanvāyātayantīti / tatra savanapadānāṃ saviśeṣaṇānāmutsargaḥ kathaṃ nāma syāt / savanābhāvādityevamarthaṃ sūtram /

src: tenaiva yajaty uddhṛtya hotāyakṣaṃ hotaryajaṃ ca
tgt: tādṛśenaivānusavanaṃ yathāsavanābhidhāyinā praiṣeṇa yajati / kimaviśeṣeṇa / netyucyate / uddhṛtya hotāyakṣamityevaṃśabdamuddhṛtya hotaryajaśabdaṃ ca / indramityasya devatādeśanasyoddhāraḥ / sapraiṣe tu na vidyata iti paribhāṣitatvāt (1.2.20) / uddhṛtyādeśapadamiti (5.4.4) cāśvalāyanasyāsaṃdigdhamādeśapadametat /

src: agne juṣasva no havir iti sviṣṭakṛtaḥ puronuvākyā
tgt: savanīyahaviḥsviṣṭakṛto vaiśvāmitrīranusavanamityādyaviśeṣaśruteḥ /

src: hotā yakṣad agniṃ puroḍāśānām ity anusavanaṃ praiṣaḥ
tgt: hotā yakṣadagniṃ purolāśānāmityevamādikaḥ sarveṣu savaneṣu haviṣpaṅktyāṃ sviṣṭakṛtpraiṣo bhavati /

anusavanameva caśabdāt / samānamanyatprātaḥsavaneneti siddhe 'nusavanavacanaṃ niyamārtham / tato yatrāpi paśupurolāśasya savanīyānāṃ va samānaḥ sviṣṭakṛttatrāpyeṣa eva praiṣo yājyā ca / avacane tu na syāt / purolāśasviṣṭakṛtsamavāye 'pi iti (5.19.3) yatnāt /
aindravāyavaśca maitrāvaruṇaśca dvau grahayāgau āśvinaśca tṛtīya ityete dvidevatyasaṃjñā anenaiva krameṇa savanīyapurolāśānantaraṃ bhavanti /

src: vāyav ā yāhi darśatendravāyū ima ity aindravāyavasya puronuvākye
tgt: mādhucchandasyāvabhirūpe dvidevatyānāṃ prathamasya puronuvākye vāheti (28.2) śruteḥ /

src: hotā yakṣad vāyuṃ hotā yakṣad indravāyū iti praiṣau
tgt: hotā yakṣadāyumagregāḥ / hotā yakṣadindravāyū arhantetyevamādiko praiṣau /

src: agraṃ piba śatenā na iti yājye
tgt: ayaṃ pibā madhūnām / śatenā no abhiṣṭibhiḥ / ete yājye bhavataḥ / śrutyantarāt /
gārtsamadīṃ ca maidhātithīṃ cottarayorabhirūpe anvāheti śruteḥ (28.2) /
hotā yakṣanmitrāvaruṇetyevamādikaḥ praiṣo (°) bhavati /
śrutyantarāt /
prātaryujā vi bodhayetyāśvinasya puronuvākyā / maidhātithīṃ ceti śruteḥ /
hotā yakṣadaśvinā nāsatyetyevamādikaḥ praiṣo bhavati /
vāvṛdhānā śubhaspatī iti yājyā / śrutyantarāt /
dvidevatyānāmayaṃ vaiśeṣiko dharmaḥ /
tasmādanavānaṃ yajatīti (13.5) śruteḥ /
itarayorasaṃbhavāt aindravāyavagrahaṇaṃ niyamārtham / tenottarayoḥ ṣaṣṭhe 'pyahani na dvau praṇavau / aindravāyavasya ca dvāveva na catvāraḥ /

aindravāyavasyaiva nānāvaṣaṭkāre eva / ataśca ṣaṣṭhe 'hanyapyaindravāyavasya dvau vaṣaṭkārau pāruchepyostadyadābhistadaharna vaṣaṭkurvantīti śrutijñāpakam / itarayorapyekaiko vaṣaṭkāraḥ / etadeva jñāpakam /
vaṣaṭkāradive 'pi sati purastājjapo yeyajāmahojaḥsahaḥ sakṛdeva /

src: aitu vasuḥ purūvasur ity aindravāyavaṃ pratigṛhyorau dakṣiṇe nidhāyānapidhānam anavekṣaṇaṃ ca dvidevatyānām ā śeṣasyāvanayanāt
tgt: aitu vasuḥ purūvasurityanena mantreṇa aindravāyavamadhvaryurhastādgṛhītvāporṇutya dakṣiṇamūruṃ tasminnidadhyāt / nihitānāṃ cācchādanamavekṣaṇaṃ ca na kuryādā pratibhakṣitasya śeṣasya ninayanāt /

src: aitu vasur vidadvasur iti maitrāvaruṇaṃ pratigṛhya dakṣiṇenaindravāyavaṃ hṛtvā dakṣiṇataḥ paścān nidadhāti
tgt: aitu vasurvidadvasurityanena mantreṇa maitrāvaruṇaṃ pratigṛhya taṃ dakṣiṇenendravāyavaṃ nītvā tasya dakṣiṇataḥ paścānnidadhāti /

src: aitu vasuḥ saṃyadvasur ity āśvinaṃ pratigṛhya dakṣiṇena pūrvau hṛtvottarataḥpaścān nidadhāti
tgt: aitu vasuḥ saṃyadvasurityanena mantreṇāśvinaṃ pratigṛhya taṃ dakṣiṇena pūrvāvaindravāyavamaitrāvaruṇau nītvā tayorevottarataḥpaścānnidadhāti / saṃlagnānnidadhyāt / abhidhānata ivābhita iti (13.5) śruteḥ / tānavagṛhyāste netpravartantā iti śruteḥ / svayaṃ dhārayet / apravartanaparatvādanyo 'pi vā dhārayet /

src: somasyāgne vīhīty anuvaṣaṭkāraḥ sarvāsu somayājyāsu dvidevatyartuyājān parihāpyādityagrahasāvitragrahau pātnīvataṃ ca
tgt: yāḥ somadravyasaṃbandhena yājyā vidhīyante tāsu sarvāsu somasyāgne vīhītyanuvaṣaṭkārasaṃjñako mantro yājyātvena bhavati / anvarthasaṃjñā ceyaṃ vaṣaṭkāramanubhavatīti / na saṃpraiṣamapekṣata ityarthaḥ / yatrāpyukthaśā yaja somānāmiti saṃpraiṣastatrāpi somasyāgne vīhītyekavacanameva / sarvagrahaṇāt / dvidevatyādīnparihāpya / nānuvaṣaṭkarotīti śruteḥ /
agnītpātnīvatasyopāṃśu yaja / mātrā tū yākṣīriti taittirīyāṇāṃ saṃpraiṣaḥ / tatra pratiṣedho 'nyatra vikalpaḥ /

src: unnīyamānebhya ity ukta ā tvā vahantu haraya ity unnīyamānasūktam
tgt: unnīyamānebhyaścamasebhya ityukta unnīyamānasūktamā tvā vahantu haraya ityetat / tā vai navānvāha nava nvā atra camasānunnayantīti (28.2) śruteḥ / ṣalu haike prātaḥsavana unnīyamānebhyo 'nvāhurityayaṃ pakṣo neṣṭaḥ sūktavacanāt / saṃpraiṣapāṭhaḥ kramārthaḥ /

src: hotā yakṣad indraṃ prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasyeti praiṣaḥ
tgt: hotā yakṣadindraṃ prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasyetyevamādikaṃ praiṣaṃ maitrāvaruṇo 'nvāha / pūrvaṃ cānuvacanam / paribhāṣitatvāt /

src: idaṃ te somyaṃ madhv iti yajati
tgt: idaṃ te somyaṃ madhviti prasthitānāṃ yājyeti (13.6) śruteḥ /

src: nṛcakṣasaṃ tvā nṛcakṣāḥ pratīkṣa iti hotṛcamasaṃ pratīkṣya vayodhasaṃ tvā vayodhāḥ pratigṛhṇāmīti pratigṛhyoraḥ saṃsparśayati dvidevatyāṃś ca
tgt: nṛcacasamityevamādinā mantreṇa hotṛcasamasaṃjñakaṃ camasaṃ hotā pratīkṣate /
vayodhasamityevamādinā mantreṇa prakṛtaṃ hotṛcamasaṃ pratigṛhṇīyāt /
prakṛtaṃ hotacamasamuraḥ saṃsparśayeddvidevatyāṃścorusthān /

pūrvamunnīyamānasūktenānūcyamānena ye camasā unnītāste sarva eva vaṣaṭkāreṇa hutāḥ / tataścatvāraḥ sadaḥ praveśitāḥ / hotṛbrahmodgātṛyajamānacamasāḥ / śiṣṭānāṃ punarunnītānāṃ vakṣyamāṇā hotrakasaṃjñakā yajanti /
mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmaha ityetayā maitrāvaruṇo yajati /
indra tvā vṛṣabhamityetayā brahmapuruṣo brāhmaṇacchaṃsī hotrako yajati /
brahmapuruṣa eva hotrakaḥ potā maruto yasya hi kṣaya ityetayā yajati /

src: ayāḍ agnīd ity ukte 'yāḍ ity āgnīdhraḥ
tgt: neṣṭādhvaryupuruṣo hotrakaḥ / so 'gne patnīrityetayā yajati /

src: sa bhadram akar yo naḥ somaṃ pāyayiṣyatīti hotā
tgt: ukṣānnāya vaśānāyetyetayāgnīdhro brahmapuruṣo hotrako yajati /

src: somaṃ bhakṣayiṣyanto yājñikair nāmadheyair asā upahvayasveti kartāro 'nyo 'nyasminn upahavam icchante
tgt: ayālagnīdityetasminnadhvaryuṇokte 'yālityāgnīdhro brūyāt / nanu kathametajjñāyate 'dhvaryuṇokta iti / ucyate / uttarasūtre hotṛvacanāt /
sa bhadramityādikaṃ savanadharmeṇāha hotā /

src: pratibhakṣitaṃ dvidevatyaśeṣaṃ nārāśaṃsavatāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ hotṛcamase 'vanayati hute tvā bhakṣitam avanayāmy ūrjasvantaṃ devebhya āyuṣmantaṃ mahyam iti
tgt: somabhakṣaparibhāṣeyam / anāramya kiṃciducyate / utkṣipya somapātraṃ prāgbhakṣaṇāt / bhakṣayiṣyanta iti bhaviṣyatprayogāt / yājñikairnāmadheyairna laukikaiḥ / asāvityāmantritakartṛnāmadheyaprayogeṇopahvayasvetyanena saha sāmarthyāt / kartāra ṛtvijo yajamānaścānyo'nyasmin karmavyatihāreṇopahavamanujñāmicchante / prārthayanta ityarthaḥ / sādhāraṇeṣu someṣvayaṃ nyāyo yujyate / kadā cidbahutaraṃ pāsyāmīti / asādhāraṇeṣu ca / nānupahūtena somaḥ pātavya iti śruteḥ /
homābhiṣavakāriṇaḥ pūrvo vaṣaṭkartā bhakṣayadvacanāt / tasmiṃśca sati tadviparītasya nyāyasyānavatārāt /

dvidevatyā aindravāyavamaitrāvaruṇāśvināḥ nārāśaṃsavantaśca grahāḥ / ājyapraugamarutvatīyaniṣkevalyavaiśvadeveṣu / eteṣāṃ pratibhakṣitamadhvaryuṇaikadeśaśeṣaṃ hotṛcamase 'vanayet / hute tvā bhakṣitamityevamādinā mantreṇa /

src: iha vasuḥ purūvasur ity aindravāyavam adhvaryave pragṛhyopahūtau vāyur indravāyū saha prāṇena saha varcasā tayor aham upahūtaḥ saha prāṇena saha varcaseti bhakṣayitvā pragrahaṇamantreṇa punaḥ pragṛhya bhakṣamantreṇa punar bhakṣayati
tgt: iha vasurityādinā mantreṇendravāyavagrahamadhvaryave dattvānantaramupūhatau vāyurityādinā bhakṣayitvā tamevaindravāyavaṃ pragrahaṇamantreṇa punaḥ pragṛhya bhakṣamantreṇa punarbhakṣayati / ūrau na niddhāti / nādhvayurmuñcati nā hotā parisaṅkhyānāt /

src: iha vasur vidadvasur iti maitrāvaruṇaṃ pragṛhya
tgt: adhvaryava iti vartate / iha vasurityādinā mantreṇa / maitrāvaruṇaṃ grahamadhvaryave pragṛhyānantaram /

src: upahūtau mitrāvaruṇau saha cakṣuṣā saha varcasā tayor aham upahūtaḥ saha cakṣuṣā saha varcaseti bhakṣayitvā
tgt: upahūtau mitrāvaruṇāvityanena mantreṇa maitrāvaruṇaṃ grahaṃ bhakṣayati /
āśvinaṃ grahaṃ tamūrorādāya śiraḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ paryāṇīya avekṣya tenaiva mārgeṇa pratyānīyāvekṣate / marvataḥ parihāramāśvinasya bhakṣayatīti (13.6) śruteḥ / avekṣaṇaṃ tu śākhāntarāt /

src: iha vasuḥ saṃyadvasur ity āśvinaṃ pragṛhya
tgt: ihādhvaryave prayacchati / na pūrvam / āśvinavacanāt /

src: upahūtau devāv aśvinau saha śrotreṇa saha varcasā tayor aham upahūtaḥ saha śrotreṇa saha varcaseti bhakṣayitvā
tgt: upahūtau devāvityevamādinā mantreṇāśvinaṃ bhakṣayitvānantaramupaspṛśya / dvidevatyabhakṣapaddhatiratrocyate / adhvarya upahyasvetyupahavamiṣṭvā tenopahūta upahūto vāyurityādinā bhakṣayet / tata uro'bhimarśanamapāmupasparśanaṃ ca / evaṃ yathoktamaindravāyavaṃ maitrāvaruṇamāśvinaṃ ca / adhvarya upahavastasya homābhiṣavakāritvāt / vaṣaṭkāranimitto hi bhakṣo dvirhi tasya vaṣaṭkarotītyaindravāyave hetvārambhāt /
upaspṛśyoṣṭhanilimpanādinā ilāmupahvayate / ilāṅgamupasparśanam / tenetarayorapi savanayorbhavati / dvidevatyānāṃ prathamo bhakṣo 'thelātha hotṛcamasa iti (13.6) śruteḥ / upasparśanaṃ śākhāntarāt /
camasādhvaryavaścamasānilāsamīpamutkṣipanti /
hotā savyena hotṛcamasaṃ pātrīṃ ca saṃyacchatīti (7) śruteḥ /
sarvatrājyalepena somasaṃsparśe varjanīyo na kevalamatra /

src: tejase tvā brahmavarcasāya bhakṣayāmīti bhakṣamantraḥ prātaḥsavane
tgt: tejase tvetyādibhakṣamantraḥ prātaḥsavane autsargikaḥ /
ojase tvetyādimantro mādhyandine savane autsargika eva /
vyavasthitaḥ pratisavanamutsargaḥ / vacanātprakaraṇaṃ bhittvā /

src: śaṃ no bhava hṛda ity uro'bhimarśanī bhakṣayitvā
tgt: śaṃ no bhava hṛda ā pīta indo ityanayoro 'bhimṛśet somaṃ bhakṣayitvā / bhakṣayitvetyatirekātsarvatra dvidevatyādiṣvapi /
etāvadāpyāyanaṃ na somāseka iti jñāpanārthaṃ yathāprāptasyopadeśasūtram /

src: ā pyāyasva sametu ta ity āpyāyanī prātaḥsavane
tgt: ā pyāyasvetyādikā ṛgāpyāyanī / tato na dravyāntaram / anayā savyahastasthitasya camamasya dakṣiṇena sparśanam / prātaḥsavanavacanātprātaḥsavana evānayā / nottarayoḥ savanayoḥ / anyathā vikalpasamuccayau syātām/
saṃ te payāṃsi samu yantu vājā itīyamāpyāyanī uttarayoḥ savanayoḥ /
hotṛbrahmodgātṛyajamānamaitrāvaruṇabrāhmaṇācchaṃsipotṛneṣṭracchāvākāgnīdhracamasāḥ savanamukhīyāḥ prasthitāḥ / tānbhakṣitapratibhakṣitānnārāśaṃsārthamāpyāyayanti /
āpyāyanaprasaṅgamupajīvannanyatrāpyāha / ājyaśastre grahabhakṣānantaraṃ ye camasāste nārāśaṃsākhyā vakṣyante / tānbhakṣitapratibhakṣitānāpyāyayanti marutvatīye ca /

ājyādiṣu yathoddiṣṭeṣu ye vaṣaṭkāreṇa camasā havirdhānasthā eva kampyante yaduktaṃ kātyāyanena nārāśaṃsānāṃ ca kampanamiti te nārāśaṃsasaṃjñāḥ / saṃvyavahārārthaṃ saṃjñākaraṇaṃ / nārāśaṃsānāṃ sannānāmupavāte nārāśaṃsa iti ca /

src: devo 'si narāśaṃso yat te medhaḥ svarjyotis tasya ta ūmaiḥ pitṛbhir bhakṣitasyopahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmīti bhakṣamantraḥ prātaḥsavane nārāśaṃsānām
tgt: devo 'sītyevamādinā nārāśaṃsānāṃ prātaḥsavane bhakṣamantraḥ / prātaḥsavanavacanamuttarayoravikalpārtham / nārāśaṃsavacanaṃ sahāpi grahaśeṣeṇāyameva nārāśaṃsānāṃ bhakṣamantra iti niyamārtham /
tasya ta ūrvaiḥ pitṛbhirityarthasaṃbandhādeva prāpnoti / vikāravacanamagniṣṭuti vikārāntarapratiṣedhārtham /
tasya te kāvyaiḥ pitṛbhiriti tṛtīyasavane prayogaḥ /

src: acchāvākaḥ sīdety ukto 'greṇa sada uttareṇa srutim upaviśya puroḍāśaṃ pratigṛhyācchāvāka vadasvety ukto 'cchā vo agnim avasa iti tisro 'nvāha
tgt: akārāntasyāpyacchāvākaśabdasya sīdetiśabdena saha saṃbandhe sakārasya dvitvaṃ chāndasam / śākhāntara evameva praiṣapāṭhāt / atha vā / acchāvākaḥ etāvatsūtramadhikārārtham / anantaraṃ karma kurvannaprasūto 'pyacchāvāka ucyate yadi sīdetyaviśeṣeṇa śākhāntare praiṣaḥ / vājasaneyināṃ praiṣo nāsti / tatrāpyāsanamāsīnanyāyaṃ bāhvṛcyamiti paribhāṣitatvāt /
agreṇa sadaso bahiḥ uttareṇa adūreṇa srutiṃ śālāmukhīyādārabhya uttaravederdvāraparaṃparayā yo mārgaḥ srutiśabdena sa ucyate tamuttareṇopaviṣya / kimanantaramityata āha /

src: yajamāna hotar adhvaryo 'gnīd brahman potar neṣṭar utopavaktar iṣeṣayadhvam ūrjorjayadhvaṃ ni vo jāmayo jihatāṃ ny ajāmayo ni sapatnā yāmani bādhitāso jeṣathābhītvarīṃ jeṣathābhītvaryāḥ śravad va indraḥ śṛṇavad vo agniḥ prasthāyendrāgnibhyāṃ somaṃ vocatopo asmān brāhmaṇān brāhmaṇā hvayadhvam iti
tgt: purolāśakhaṇḍamadhvaryuṇā dattaṃ gṛhītvā tataḥ /

src: upahavam ayaṃ brāhmaṇa icchate 'cchāvāko vety adhvaryur āha taṃ hotar upahvayasveti
tgt: kramārthaṃ saṃpraiṣavacanam / keṣāṃ cidabhyadhiko 'pi saṃpraiṣaḥ /
acchā vo agnimavasa ityevamādyā ṛco 'cchāvākastisro 'nvāha /

src: praty etā vāmā sūktāyaṃ sunvan yajamāno agrabhīd uta pratiṣṭhotopavakta uta no gāva upahūtā utopahūta ity upahvāsyamānaḥ
tgt: tisṛṇāṃ yo 'ntyo praṇavastṛtīye vacane tena saṃtataṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ nigadamāha /

src: uta no gāva upahūtā ity āto 'nupahvāsyamānaḥ
tgt: ayaṃ nigadaḥ / etasminnacchāvākenokte /

src: anupahūto 'cchāvāko nivartadhvam iti sūktasya yāvac chaknuyāt tāvad anudravet
tgt: sarvārtho'yaṃ madhye 'dhvaryuvacanāt dvitīya upahavamayamityādistaṃ hotarupayasveti hotrarthaḥ /
ayaṃ tāvatprathamaḥ kalpaḥ / yadā hotā nopahvayate tadetara upahvayerannuttarasmādyatnāt /

src: unnīyamānāyety uktaḥ praty asmai pipīṣata ity acchāvākaḥ sūktam anvāha
tgt: unnīyamānāyānubrūhītyevamadhvaryuṇā saṃpreṣitaḥ pratyasmai pipīṣata ityetatsūktamanvāha caturṛcam / svayamacchāvākaḥ saptamīmiti pakṣāntaraśruteḥ / sūktavacanaṃ svābhipretasidhyartham / acchāvākavacanaṃ maitrāvaruṇanivṛttyartham /
prātaryāvabhirā gatamityaindrāgnyā yajatīti (28.7) śruteḥ /

src: bhakṣitāpyāyitaṃ camasam adhvaryave pradāya dakṣiṇāvṛd aparayā dvārā sadaḥ prapadya svasya dhiṣṇyasya paścād upaviśya puroḍāśaṃ prāśnāti
tgt: pūrvaprasṛptasyācchāvākīyāṃ kurvataḥ samākhyābhakṣo na prāpnoti / tadarthaṃ bhakṣitavacanam / aprasthitatvādāpyāyanaṃ na prāpnoti / tadarthamāpyāyitavacanam / adhvaryave pradāyeti nārāśaṃsasādanārtham / tathā ca kātyāyanaḥ / hotṛcamasavatsarvamityāha / dakṣiṇāvṛdityādi niyamārtham / sadovacanaṃ divaspṛṣṭhamityādikriyārtham / svasya dhiṣṇyasya paścādupaviśya nirgatya purolāśaṃ prāpnoti / ucchiṣṭadoṣaparihārārthaṃ nirgamanam /
hotā sva eva dhiṣṇye sthito 'cchāvākīyāṃ karoti / nācchāvākīye / tuśabdenānyasyāpi hotrakasya hotṛdhiṣṇya eva prāptirdṛḍhīkṛtā /

hotṛvikārāṇāṃ ca maitrāvaruṇaprabhṛtīnāṃ / hotrakāṇāṃ yā yājyāstāḥ svadhiṣṇya eva sthito hotā kuryāt / gatvā vā tadīyaṃ dhiṣṇyam / vyagreṣu vā hotrakeṣu prāptiḥ śākhāntarīyādvacanāt / praiṣānuvacanaśastrādīni svadhiṣṇya eva / yājyāvacanāt /
adhikāro 'yam /

atra prātaḥsavane prasthitayāge hotrakā hotā cānavānanto anucchramanto 'rdharceṣu yajanti / tathā ca śruteḥ / kṣipraṃ devebhyo haviḥ pradāsyāma iti hetvarthavādāt / ardharcaśo vetyardharcaśaḥ prāptau / na tu ṣaṣṭhe 'hani vikalpo 'navānavacanāttatra /
kartāra ityanuvartate / atreti ca / yajñakartāro 'tra vratayanti / vrataṃ kurvanti bhuñjanta ityarthaḥ / vratayantīti kriyābhidhānātsārvakāmikamiti gamyate /
niyamārtho 'thaśabdaḥ pūrvasyāśanasthāniyamaṃ darśayitum / ṛtuyājairiti saṃjñākaraṇaṃ saṃvyavahārārtham / caranti pracaranti tānkurvantītyarthaḥ /

src: hotā yakṣad indraṃ hotrād ity ṛtupraiṣair anavānaṃ preṣyati
tgt: hotā yakṣadindraṃ hotrādityevamādibhirṛtupraiṣasaṃjñakairanavānaṃ prāṇasaṃtatenetyarthaḥ / preṣyati maitrāvaruṇaḥ svartupraiṣeṇāpi / nanu praiṣapraiṣārthayorekasminkartari nyāyavirodhaḥ / ucyate / syādetadyadi praiṣasyāpūrvārthabhāvanā syāt / atra gṛhapatipraiṣe vikāreṣūhaḥ / sa ucyate / dviyajamānake sugṛhapatau / bahuyajamānake sugṛhapatayaḥ / dviyajamānake imau sunvantau yajamānau / bahuyajamānake ime sunvanto yajamānāḥ / sugṛhapatistvamityanūhyamagnyabhidhānatvāt / anena sunvatā yajamānenāsya dvitvabahutvayorūhaḥ / ābhyāṃ sunvadbhyāṃ yajamānābhyāṃ / ebhiḥ sunvadbhiryajamānaiḥ / gṛhapatī yajataṃ evaṃ dviyajamānake / gṛhapatayo yajadhvamiti bahuyajamānake / syādityetasya sthāne dvitvabahutvayorbhūyāstāṃ bhūyāsuriti / gṛhapate yajetyasya sthāne gṛhapatī yajatamityevamūho rāśimarāyādiṣu / gṛhapatayo yajadhvamiti śalalīpiśaṅge / sattreṣvekasyaiva gṛhapativyapadeśādyajamānabahutve 'pi gṛhapatiśabdo yajamānapadamapi sanna vikriyate /
anavānamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ pūrvavat /

src: yena preṣyati sā yājyoddhṛtya hotāyakṣam asauyajaṃ ca
tgt: yenayena preṣyati maitrāvaruṇaḥ sāsā yājyā / tasyatasya praiṣāntoktasya iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ / uddhṛtya hotāyacacchabdaṃ pratipraiṣaṃ cāmuka yajāmuka yajeti /

indra somaṃ piba ṛtunetyetā vā hotrādibhiryājyāḥ kartavyāḥ / maidhātithyo vetyārṣavacanānniyamataḥ / trayodaśasyāpyṛtugrahasyādhvaryuvaśātprayoge sati maidhātibhyeva kāryā aviniyuktā viniyuktānāṃ yātayāmatvadoṣāt / praiṣasya tvekasya yadyapi yathādevatamadhvaryuvaśādyājyābhyāso 'saṃbhavādanyasya / tadanusāreṇa praiṣāntaśrutasya ṛtudevatātulyadevatā vṛddhaiḥ kalpitā evaṃ likhyante / ā tvā vahantu haraya ityaindrī / haskarādvidyutasparīti mārūtī / iha tvaṣṭāramagriyamiti tvāṣṭrī / agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe ityāgneyī / ṛtena yāvṛtāvṛdhāviti maitrāvaruṇī / prātaryujā vi bodhayetyāśvinī / drāviṇodasaṃ praiṣaṃ nābhyasyet ṛgyājyākalpaścedaṅgīkṛtaḥ / kutaḥ / talliṅgāyā ṛco 'saṃbhavāt / sa ya icchenmṛtyuṃ pāpmānamapahanyāmityetābhiryajedityarthavādāt / yena preṣyati sā yājyetyayameva pakṣaḥ sarvasvāraparākayoḥ / agniṣṭuti ca praiṣayājyākalpo 'nūhyatvādṛcaḥ /

src: yo yaḥ praiṣānte śrūyate sa sa yajati
tgt: yoyo hotrādiḥ praiṣānte śrūyate hotaryaja potaryajetyevaṃ sasa yajatīndra somamityāmnāyakrameṇa / praśāstaryajeti maitrāvaruṇo brahman yajeti brāhmaṇācchaṃsī /
adhvaryū yajatamiti praiṣānte hotaretadyajetyadhvaryurāha / evamukto hotā kramaprāptāṃ tadīyāṃ yājyāmāha /
gṛhapate yajetyetatpraiṣānte yajamāna āha hotaretadyajeti / tato hotā yajati /
tayoḥ saṃbandhinyau kramaprāptāvityarthaḥ /
yeṣāmadhvaryūṇāmasarvahutāstaiḥ saha kriyāyāmevaṃ bhavati / tatra yo yasya homakārī sa tasminnupahavamiṣṭvā sāvanena bhakṣamantreṇāvajighratyoṣṭhau vā nilimpati /

ante 'dhvaryau pratiprasthātari vopahavamiṣṭvā sāvanena mantreṇa yathoktaṃ bhakṣaṇam / punaḥ pratiprasthātaryevopahavamiṣṭvā / evaṃ dvirantato hotā / adhvaryugṛhapatyorbhakṣo mā bhūditi sūtrārambhaḥ / vājibhiḥ saha kriyāyāṃ pūrveṣāṃ daśānāmabhakṣaṇameva / sarvahutatvāt /

src: limped ivaiva jighred atra dvidevatyeṣu ceti
tgt: evo niyoge / ivaśabdaḥ saṃpratyarthe 'narthaḥ / atra ṛtuyājeṣu bhakṣayitṛbhiroṣṭhalepanaṃ vā kartavyamavaghrāṇaṃ vā / na pātavyaḥ somaḥ / dvidevatyeṣvapyevameva / tatrokte hotureva kevalasya syāt / athartuyājaiścarantītyathaśabdasyāsya cetikaraṇasyaitatprayojanam / kathaṃ nāmetarayoḥ savanayoḥ sarvametatpratiṣidhyatehotṛsaṃbandhasya kevalasya pratiṣedho mā bhūditi /

src: ājyaṃ śaṃsiṣyan pitā mātariśvācchidrā padośig asīyānutakṣiṣat somo nīthavin nīthāni neṣad bṛhaspatir ukthāmadāni śaṃsiṣad iti japitvā śoṃsāvo3 ity āhāvaḥ śastrādau prātaḥsavane tenāhūyopāṃśu tūṣṇīṃśaṃsam
tgt: ājyamiti vakṣyamāṇasya śastrasya nāmadheyam / tacchaṃsiṣyanpitā mātariśvetyevamādikaṃ mantraṃ japitvā tataḥ śoṃsāvo3 ityāhāvasaṃjñakaḥ plutāntaḥ / āyanigadaścāyaṃ pratisavanaṃ yathā paṭhitastena pratiprasthātrādiṣvapi pratigṛṇatsu na vikriyate / śastrādāviti vacanātsarvatra śastrādāvayamautsargikaḥ / prātaḥsavanavacanaṃ prātaḥsavaniko 'yamityasya pratipādanārtham / tenāhūya tenatena yo yatrāhāvākhyastenatena pratigaritāramāhūya tata upāṃśu tūṣṇīṃ śaṃsākhyamagnirjyotirityādikaṃ śaṃset /

src: agnir jyotir jyotir agnir ity avasāyendro jyotir jyotir indra ity avasāya sūryo jyotir jyotiḥ sūrya ity avasāya paccho 'vasyan purorucam
tgt: niyamato 'vasānārthamiha sarvatrāvasānavacanaṃ / nāyamāyanigadaḥ / prauge purorucāmṛgvacanāt / tataśca vikṛtiṣu yathārthamūhaḥ / evametaṃ tūṣṇīṃśaṃsaṃ śastvā tataḥ purorucamanantarāṃ paccho 'vasyan śaṃset /

src: agnir deveddhaḥ / agnir manviddhaḥ / agniḥ susamit / hotā devavṛtaḥ / hotā manuvṛtaḥ / praṇīr yajñānām / rathīr adhvarāṇām / atūrto hotā / tūrṇir havyavāṭ / ā devo devān vakṣat / yakṣad agnir devo devān / so 'dhvarā karati jātavedo3 pra vo devāyety ājyam
tgt: agnirdeveddha ityādikāṃ purorucaṃ praṇavāntāṃ yathāpaṭhitāṃ śaṃset / vikāreṣvanāyanigadatvādiyamūhitavyā /
praṇavena pra vo devāyetyājyasūktaṃ saṃdadhyāt / sūktavivṛddhāvapi prathamasya sūktasyāyaṃ dharmastasyetyatirekāt /
marutvatīyaṃ nāma mādhyandine savane prathamaṃ śastram / tathā vaiśvadevaṃ tṛtīyasavane / tayośca śastrayoḥ / na kevalamājyasya prathamasya sūktasya prathamamardharcaṃ paccho 'navānaṃ śaṃset /

src: sūktaśeṣaṃ śastvāhūyottamayā paridhāyokthavīryaṃ japati bhā vibhā uṣāḥ svarjyotiḥ ślokāya tvoktham avācīti
tgt: ṛtāvā yasya rodasītyevamādikamuttamāvarjaṃ sūktaśeṣaṃ śastvā tata āhūya āhāvamuktvetyarthaḥ / uttamayā paridhāya śastraṃ parisamāpyetyarthaḥ / ukthavīryasaṃjñakaṃ tadaṅgaṃ mantraṃ japati bhā vibhā ityevamādikam / nanu sūktaśeṣaṃ śasvetyatiricyate / satyam / āvāpeṣu sati sambhave sakalasūktasya prakṣepa ityetat jñāpayituṃ sūktaśeṣaṃ śastveti vacanam / tathā ca śrutihetvarthavādaḥ kvacit / tadu ha smāha kauṣītakiḥ śaṃsedeva sūktasyāvyavacchedāyeti /

src: ukthaśā ity adhvaryur āha sarvāsu śastrayājyāsu
tgt: śastrayājyāsampreṣanimittamukthaśā ityadhvaryurāha sarvāsu śastrayājyāsu / na kevalamatraiva /
agna indraśca dāśuṣo duroṇa iti yajati / tathā śravaṇāt /

yadājye śastre samāpte stuvate chandogāstasyaivānuśaṃsanametadityetadarthaḥ sūtrārambhaḥ / nanu sarvatra vācanikamājyam / ko 'sya viṣayaḥ / ucyate / vācaḥstome kvacitkālpanikeṣu śastreṣu / anyeṣāṃ śastrāṇāṃ pūrvaṃ stotramanantaraṃ śastramasya tūttaraṃ stotram / pavamānastotrāṇi praugamarutvatīyavaiśvadevānāmeva śrutatvāt /

src: stotravatāṃ śastrāṇām eṣeti prāhottamāt pratīhārād ūrdhvam āhūya śaṃsanti
tgt: paribhāṣāsūtrametadiha kriyate / praugasya vyavahitastotrasyāpyājyastotreṇa sāmasantatiryathā syāt / stotravatāṃ śastrāṇam / na tu sautrāmaṇī śastraprabhṛtīnāṃ śākhāntaradṛṣṭānāṃ stotravatāmayaṃ dharmaḥ / eṣeti prāha stotrakārī / tasyāyamarthaḥ / eṣottamā ṛk śaṃsatu bhavāniti / uttamātpratīhārādūrdhvamiti / pratīhāraḥ sāmabhaktiviśeṣaḥ / sa uttamatvena viśeṣyate / tasmādūrdhvamāhūya pratigaritāraṃ tataḥ śaṃsanti / āhūyeti vacanādāhāvo na śastram / tena tanmohe na prāyaścittam /

src: prauge 'ntareṇa mādhucchandasāṃstṛcān ṛco vyavayanti tāḥ puroruca ity ācakṣate
tgt: prauge vakṣyamāṇe yā antareṇa mādhucchandasāṃstṛcānvāyavā yāhi darśateti vakṣyamāṇakānṛco vyavayanti vyavadadhatītyarthaḥ / tāḥ puroruca ityācakṣate/ prasiddhā hi tāsāmiyaṃ saṃjñetyarthaḥ / praugagrahaṇaṃ saṃjñārtham / tataśca śāstre saṃvyavahārasiddhijñānācca dharmaḥ / mādhucchandasāniti praugasya saṃjñārthaṃ pūrvavatprayojanam / ṛco vyavayantīti purorucāmṛgvacanaṃ vikāreṣvanūhārtham / purorugvacanamṛksaṅkhyāyāṃ nāmagrahaṇārthaṃ na kevalaṃ saṃjñārthameva / śrutiprasiddhatvāttasyāḥ /
tāsāṃ purorucāṃ purastātpratyekamāhāvaḥ / saṃśasya purorucā sūktaṃ puroruce puroruca evāhūyata iti (14. 4) śruteḥ /
paridhānīyāyāśca purastādāhāvaḥ kāryaḥ /
viśvāndevānhavāmaha ityeṣā vaiśvadevī puroruk / ṣaṭpadā eva jāgate sarvele'pi / mā ṣaṭpadā bhavatīti niyamaśruteḥ /

src: tasyāṃ dvābhyāṃ dvābhyām avasāya dvābhyāṃ praṇauti
tgt: tasyāṃ ṣaṭpadāyāṃ dvābhyāṃ pādābhyāmavasāya tato 'nantarābhyāṃ punaravasāya punaśca dvābhyāṃ praṇauti / nātra gāyatrīśaṃsanamavasānopadeśāt / vināśe cāvasānādāvṛttiḥ / tasyai dvedve pade avagrāhaṃ śaṃsatauti (5) śruteḥ /

src: sārasvatyāṃ vikalpaḥ / śaṃsen na vā / nityas tv āhāvaḥ
tgt: sārasvatyāṃ puroruci vācaḥ stome 'pi vikalpaḥ / śaṃsenna vā śaṃset / aśaṃsanamevābhīṣṭaṃ tena gurusūtraṃ kṛtam / tathā ca śrutiḥ / atra haike sārasvatīṃ purorucaṃ śaṃsati na tathā kuryāt / āhāvastu nityaḥ / tadaṅgatvādikalpe prāpte vacanam / evaṃ ca sati nitarāṃ paridhānīyāṃ śaṃsediti (7.20.10) niṣkevalye / tatrāhāvasyāpi tādaṅgyāttaddharmatā / aṅgapradhānayoḥ saṃsvāranyāyatā yuktyā / nanu prativacanamāhāvaḥ prāpnoti / netyucyate / tantraṃ bhavatyabhinnakālatvāt / evaṃ ca saṅkhyopapattiḥ / ṣoḍaśāhāvaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ śaṃsatyekaviṃśatyāhāvamāgnimārutaṃ śaṃsatīti /

src: vāyur agregā yajñaprīḥ sākaṃ gan manasā yajñam / śivo niyudbhiḥ śivābhiḥ // iti sakṛc chastvā vāyav ā yāhi darśateti tisṛṇāṃ triḥ prathamām
tgt: āhūya vāyuragregā ityādikāṃ vāyavyāṃ purorucaṃ sakṛcchastvā tato vāyavā yāhi darśatetyetāsāṃ tisṛṇaṃ triḥ prathamāṃ śaṃset / vāyavā yāhi darśatetyetāstisraḥ śaṃsettāsāṃ ca prathamāṃ tririti vākyabhede 'pi sūtreṣu na doṣaḥ /

src: hiraṇyavartanī narā devā patī abhiṣṭaye / vāyuś cendraś ca sumakhau // indravāyū ima iti tisraḥ
tgt: āhūya hiraṇyavartanī ityevamādikāmaindravāyavīṃ purorucaṃ śastvā tata indravāyū ime sutā ityetāstisraḥ śaṃset /

src: kāvyayor ājāneṣu kratvā dakṣasya duroṇe / riśādasā sadhastha ā // mitraṃ huva iti tisraḥ
tgt: āhūya kāvyayo rājānetyevamādikāṃ purorucaṃ śastvā tato mitraṃ huve pūtadakṣamityetāstisraḥ śaṃset /

src: daivyāv adhvaryū ā gataṃ rathena sūryatvacā / madhvā yajñaṃ samañjāthe // aśvinā yajvarīr iṣa iti tisraḥ
tgt: āhūya daivyāvadhvaryū ityevamādikāṃ purorucaṃ śastvā tato 'śvinā yajvarīriṣa ityetāstisraḥ śaṃset /

src: indra ukthebhir bhandiṣṭho vājānāṃ ca vājapatiḥ / harivān sutānāṃ sakhā // indrā yāhi citrabhāno iti tisraḥ
tgt: āhūyendra ukthebhirityādikāṃ purorucaṃ śastvā tata indrā yāhi citrabhāno iti tisraḥ śaṃset /

src: viśvān devān havāmahe 'smin yajñe sajoṣasaḥ / ta imaṃ yajñam āgaman devāso devyā dhiyā / ye yajñasya tanūkṛto viśva ā somapītaye / omāsaś carṣaṇīdhṛta iti tisraḥ
tgt: āhūya viśvāndevānityevamādikāṃ purorucaṃ ṣaṭpadāṃ śastvā tata omāmañcarṣaṇīdhṛta ityetāstisraḥ śaṃset /

src: vācām ahaṃ devīṃ vācam asmin yajñe supeśasam / sarasvatīṃ havāmahe // pāvakā naḥ sarasvatīti tisṛṇām uttamayā paridhāyokthavīryaṃ japati vācaṃ me jinva / prāṇaṃ me tṛmpa / cakṣur me pāhi / śrotraṃ me 'va / varṇaṃ me yaccha / tanvaṃ me pāhi / yaśo me dhehi / ghoṣāya tvoktham avācīti
tgt: āhūya vācāmahamityevamādikāṃ purorucaṃ pakṣe śastvā tataḥ pāvakā naḥ sarasvatīti tisṛṇāmuttamayā paridhāyānantaramukthavīryaṃ vācaṃ me jinvetyevamādikaṃ japati / vācaṃ me jinvetyetaiḥ saptabhirvākyaiḥ saptaiva vāyavyāditṛcadevatā āśiṣaḥ prārthyante / tatra sārasvatatṛcābhāve 'pi daśamamahādau saptaivāśīrvākyāni kathaṃ nāma syurityevamarthamukthavīryagrahaṇam / anvarthasaṃjñā vijñānātsamudāyāṅgamityarthaḥ /
viśvebhiḥ somyaṃ madhvityukthaṃ śastvā yajatīti (5) śruteḥ /
paribhāṣeyam/ stotriyānurūpā uccamānāstṛcāḥ pratyetavyāḥ / kimaviśeṣeṇa / netyāha / pragāthānparihāpya pragāthānvarjayitvetyarthaḥ /

src: ā no mitrāvaruṇā no gantam iti stotriyānurūpau maitrāvaruṇasya
tgt: ā no mitrāvaruṇeti stotriyaḥ / ā no gantaṃ riśādasetyanurūpaḥ / vaiśvāmitrau maitrāvaruṇasya cācchāvākasya ca stotriyau bhavata iti śruteḥ /
pra vo mitrāya gāyateti pañcarcamukthamukham / ukthamukhavacanādvācaḥstome 'syordhvamāvāpaḥ / ahargaṇe tu naivam / hotrakāṇāṃ prātaḥsavane karmeti karmavacanātirekāt śruteśca /

src: pra mitrayor iti navānām uttamayā paridhāyopa naḥ sutam ā gatam iti yajati
tgt: pra mitrayorvaruṇayorityetāsāṃ navānāmanuvādena vidhiḥ / uttamayā paridhāya samāpya śastram upa naḥ sutamā gatamiti etayā yajati /
ā yāhi suṣumā hi ta iti stotriyaḥ / ā no yāhi parāvata ityanurūpaḥ / brāhmaṇācchaṃsina ṛtvigviśeṣasya /
vāstoṣpate dhruvetyeva pragātho bārhato dvṛca iti taṃ parihāpya śeṣaḥ sūktasya ayamu vā vicarṣaṇa ityādikaṃ saptakamukthamukhaṃ bhavati /
indra tvā vṛṣabhaṃ vayamiti navarcametatsūktaṃ śaṃset /

src: ud ghed abhīti tisṛṇām uttamayā paridhāyendrakratuvidam iti yajati
tgt: udghedabhi śrutāmaghamiti tisṛṇāmanuvādasarūpo vidhiḥ / tāsāmuttamayā paridhāya samāpya śastram / tata ukthaśā yaja somānāmiti saṃpreṣita indra ṛtuvidaṃ stutamiti yajati /

src: indrāgnī ā gataṃ sutam ity acchāvākasya stotriyānurūpau
tgt: krameṇa pūrvaḥ stotriya uttaro 'nurūpaḥ / āvantaḥ stotriyānurūpāstrayāṇāmapi hotrakāṇām / tathaiva śrutatvāt / vaiśvāmitrau maitrāvaruṇācchāvākayoḥ / evameva śrutatvāt /
tṛca evokthamukhaṃ navarcatvāt sūktasya /
anantarametāḥ śastavyāḥ /

src: iyaṃ vāmasya manmana iti navānām uttamayā paridhāyendrāgnī ā gataṃ sutam iti yajati
tgt: vāsiṣṭhau navarcau paryāsāviti śruteḥ / iyaṃ vāmasya manmana ityetāsāṃ navānāmuttamayā paridhāyendrāgnau ā gataṃ sutamiti yajati / pūrvavadukthaśā yaja somānāmiti saṃpreṣitaḥ /

src: mitraṃ vayam indram id gāthina indra agneti stotriyā bṛhatpṛṣṭhasya
tgt: vakṣyati / rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ niṣkevalyasya bṛhadveti / tatra rathantare kriyamāṇe rathantarapṛṣṭho yajñaḥ / bṛhati kriyamāṇe bṛhatpṛṣṭhatā syāt / ataśca rathantaraṣpṛṣṭhapakṣe pūrvokta eva śastranyāsaḥ / bṛhatpṛṣṭhapakṣe tvayamucyate / maitrāvaruṇādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ prakṛtatvādyathāsaṅkhyena sambandhaḥ / mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmaha iti maitrāvaruṇasya stotriyaḥ / indramidgāthino bṛhaditi brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ / indre agnā namo bṛhadityacchāvākasya / bṛhatpṛṣṭhasyeti yajñaviśeṣaṇam / arthaḥ prakṛtiṃ nivartayatīti pūrveṣāṃ nivṛttiḥ /
rāthantaramiti taddhitasaṃbandhāt pūrvā rathantaraṣpṛṣṭhapakṣe śastraracaneti siddham /

anurūpaṃ rāthantaramacchāvāka ukthamukhaṃ kurute / rāthantaramutsṛjet / sa vā eṣo 'gniṣṭoma ājyaprabhṛtyāgnimārutānto yacchasyaṃ trīṇi ṣaṣṭhiśatānyṛcāṃ sampadyanta iti (16.9) śruteḥ / indre agneti ca paryāsamadhye punaḥśaṃsanaṃ viniyuktasyāpi stotriyatve / vāsiṣṭhau navarcau paryāsāviti śruteḥ /
hotrakā maitrāvaruṇabrāhmaṇācchaṃsyacchāvākāḥ svaśastreṣu sarvatra caturāhāvā bhavantītyayamutsargaḥ /
vakṣyati / āśvinādūrdhvamatiriktokthāni / ūrdhvaṃ ṣoḍaśino 'tiriktokthamityādau / teṣvatiriktoktheṣu hotā caturāhāvo bhavati / caturāhāvaśabdaścakāreṇānukṛṣyate /

src: stotriyānurūpābhyāṃ yac cānantaram anurūpāt paridhānīyāyai ca
tgt: anyapadārthagato 'pyāhāvaśabdo 'dhikriyate dṛṣṭato adhikārapravṛtteḥ / stotriyānurūpābhyāṃ pratyekamāhāvaḥ / caturāhāvā hotrakā iti vacanāt / āhāvasthānaniyamārthaṃ sūtram /

src: anurūpād anantaraḥ pragāthas tasmād ūrdhvaṃ pañcamaṃ madhyandine
tgt: anurūpādanantaro yaḥ pragāthaḥ prakṛto tasmādūrdhvaṃ pañcamamāhāvasthāna hotrakāṇāṃ mādhyandine savane bhavati /
ukthamukhādūrdhvaṃ pañcamamāhāvasthānaṃ sarveṣāṃ hotuśca hotrakāṇāṃ ca rātrau / rātriparyāyeṣvityarthaḥ /

src: yadādhvaryur āha praśāstaḥ prasuhīty oṃ sarpateti praśāstāha
tgt: anyatrāpi savanānte 'nyatra vā yadādhvaryurevamāha praśāstaḥ prasuhīti tadā maitrāvaruṇa oṃ sarpateti brūyāt /

src: dakṣiṇāvṛto 'parayā dvārā niḥsarpanty uttareṇaudumbarīṃ dakṣiṇena brahmā
tgt: prasūtāḥ santo dakṣiṇāvṛto dakṣiṇena śarīrabhāgena parivṛtā ityarthaḥ / aparayā sadodvārā niḥsarpanti / nāniyamena / kathaṃ tarhi / uttareṇaudumbarīsaṃjñāṃ sthūṇām / tāmeva dakṣiṇena brahmā niḥsarpet / nanu svaṃsvaṃ dhiṣṇyamuttareṇa saṃcaratāmuttareṇaudumbarīṃ sarpaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati / kiṃ vacanena / ucyate / yajamānasadasyamaitrāvaruṇagrāvastudartham / yathā na śūnyaṃ sado bhavati tathā sadasyaḥ prasarpet / sarpatsu na śūnyaṃ sadaḥ kuryāditi tasya chāndogye vacanāt / āgnīdhrastu svasmādagārāddakṣiṇayā dvārā / tathā saṃbhavāt /
yathārthamṛtvijo mūtrapurīṣādikaraṇāya sarpanti /

src: mādhyandināya savanāya yathāniḥsṛptaṃ prasṛpya yathāsanam upaviśanti
tgt: mādhyandināya savanāyeti tādarthe caturthī / tataśca samastopasthānaprabhṛtinā prasarpaṇamūrdhvaṃ prātaḥsavanādityetatsiddhaṃ bhavati / aparayaiva dvārā prasarpeyuḥ / yathāniḥsṛptamiti vacanāt / yathāsanamupaviśantītyayamanuvādo dakṣiṇadhiṣṇyo ityasya niṣedhārthaḥ /

ādau mādhyandinasya savanasya rājānamabhiṣuṇvantyadhvaryavaḥ / grāvastutkarmāvadhyarthametatsūtram / nanu rājānamabhiṣuṇvantītyetāvadvācyam anyatkramaprakaraṇābhyāṃ siddham / ucyate / mādhyandinasya savanasyāyamādirityetadapi pratipādayitavyameva / kathaṃ nāma / yāni mādhyandinādāvupadiśyante preṅkhāvaṭakhananādīni tāni prāgabhiṣavātkriyeranniti /

src: grāvastut pūrvayā dvārā havirdhāne prapadyottarasya havirdhānasya dakṣiṇaṃ cakram agreṇa dakṣiṇā tiṣṭhan somopanahanena mukhaṃ pariveṣṭya grāvaghoṣaṃ śrutvāsaṃpreṣito 'bhiṣṭauty asaṃtanvann ardharcaśo 'navānaṃ vā
tgt: grāvastudṛtvigviśeṣaḥ / sa pūrvayā dvārā havirdhānaśaraṇaṃ praviśyottarasya havirdhānaśakaṭasya dakṣiṇaṃ pādamagreṇa dakṣiṇābhimukhastiṣṭhansomopanahanena vāsasā mukhamuttamāṅgaṃ pariveṣṭya grāvṇāṃ somamabhiṣuṇvatāṃ śabdaṃ śrutvā saṃpraiṣanirapekṣaṃ praṇavenāsaṃdadhat pratyardharcamucchvasannanavānaṃ vā vakṣyamāṇamanuvacanaṃ paṭhati /

src: abhi tvā deva savitar yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiya ā tū na indra kṣumantam ā no bhara dakṣiṇenopa kramasvā bhara
tgt: pratīkoktāḥ pañcaitā ṛco 'bhiṣṭauti / śākhāntaraśruteḥ /

src: ā pyāyasva sametu ta ity āpyāyitavatīnāṃ tisṛṇāṃ prathamām abhiṣṭutyārbudasya dve
tgt: ā pyāyasva sametu te / ā pyāyasva madintama / saṃ te payāṃsi samu yantu vājā ityāpyāyitavatyaḥ / etāsāṃ tisṛṇāṃ prathamāmabhiṣṭutya tataḥ praite vadantu pra vayaṃ vadāmetyarbudārṣasya sūtrasya dve abhiṣṭauti / devā vā arbudena ca pāvamānobhiśca grāvṇo 'bhiṣṭutyāpnuvannamṛtatvamiti śruteḥ / arbudagrahaṇaṃ vyavahārārtham /

dvitīyāmāpyāyitavatīnāmā pyāyasva madintametyetāmāpyāyitavatīmabhiṣṭutyārbudasya dve / ete vadantyavidannanā madhvityetāmabhiṣṭutya tataḥ suparṇā vācamakratopa dyavītyetāmabhiṣṭuyāt / <7.15.6 6. tṛtīyāmāpyāyitavatīnāṃ saṃ te payāṃsītyetāmabhiṣṭutya tato 'rbudasyaikāṃ ugrā iva pravahantaḥ samāyayurityetāmabhiṣṭuyāt /

src: mṛjanti tvā daśa kṣipa etam u tyaṃ daśa kṣipa etaṃ mṛjanti marjyam iti mṛṣṭavatīr abhiṣṭutya
tgt: tulyapratīkatve prāthamyena vyavasthā / mṛṣṭavatīriti saṃjñā / kathaṃ nāmādhavanakriyākāle syuḥ /

src: ā kalaśā anūṣatā kalaśeṣu dhāvati pari pra soma te rasa iti kalaśavatīr abhiṣṭutya
tgt: atrāpi pūrvavatsaṃjñākaraṇaprayojanam /

src: āpyāyitavatīprabhṛty evaṃ vihṛto dvitīyo 'pi savaḥ / ṣaṣṭhīprabhṛtayaḥ pañcārbudasya
tgt: ā pyāyasva sametu ta ityetatprabhṛti kalaśavatyanta evaṃ vihṛtaḥ pūrvavadāpyāyitavatyarbudavyasto dvitīyo 'pi savaḥ / apiśabdāt prathamo 'pi kalaśavatyantaḥ savasaṃjña eva / iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ / ṣaṣṭhīprabhṛtayaḥ pañcārbudasya pūrvavadvihartavyāḥ /
āpyāyitavatīprabhṛtyekādaśīprabhṛtayastisro 'rbudasya vihartavyāḥ / tatra yathāsaṃbhavamekaikāṃ viharedayamapi tṛtīyaḥ savaḥ / saṃjñākaraṇaṃ śāstrasaṃvyavahārārtham /

src: yasmin save bṛhacchabdaṃ kuryur bṛhad vadantīti tatra
tgt: yasminsave 'bhiṣotāro bṛhacchabdaṃ kuryurbṛhadvadanti madireṇa mandineti tatrotkarṣet / atha yatra bṛhadbṛhaditi bṛhadvadanti madireṇa mandineti tatreti (29.1) śruteḥ /
prathame save ṣaṣṭhīmapakarṣet /

src: vitate pavitre pavitraṃ ta iti dve vi yat pavitram ity ekā
tgt: pavitramūrṇāmayaṃ somagalanārthamudgātāro vitanvanti / tasminvitate sati pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇaspata iti dve abhiṣṭuyāt / 14. vitata eva pavitre vi yatpavitraṃ dhiṣaṇā atanvatetyekā paṭhitavyā /

src: prāsya dhārāḥ pra dhārā asya pra te dhārā iti prakṣarantīṣu dhārāsu
tgt: prāsya dhārā acaranpra dhārā asya śubhiṇaḥ / pra te dhārā asaścata iti prāthamyāt / etāstisraḥ pra carantīṣu dhārāṣu paṭhet / dhārāsviti bahuvacanamavivakṣitam / kālopalakṣaṇatvāt /

pāvamānīnāṃ madhye yāḥ kāmayeta tā abhiṣṭuyāt / dhārāgraheṣu gṛhyamāṇeṣvadhvaryubhiḥ / avacane prathamā eva syuḥ / prathamaṃ vā niyamyeti nyāyadarśanāt / tulye 'pi pāvamānītve saumya eva syuḥ prakaraṇāt / na tu mṛṣṭavatyādyāḥ / viniyuktatvāt / sūtrakārānuprasthānādanuṣṭubho yuktāḥ / tathā hi daśame 'hani mṛjāno vāre pavamāno avyaya iti grāvastuto yāthākāmyamityetadupapannaṃ bhavati / tathā ca tatkṛtvābhi no vājasātamamityetā anuṣṭubhaḥ prāthamyātprakṛtau prasiddhāḥ /
yāthākāmyanivṛttyarthaṃ yamerbandhanārthasya prayogaḥ /
uttame grahe gṛhīta iti kālavidhiḥ / arbudasyottamayā paridhāyeti niyamaḥ / ādāyoṣṇīṣamutsṛjyata ityuṣṇīṣādānavidhiḥ / vāgyamādiniyamakarmaṇaścotsargaḥ /
pratyahamuṣṇīṣādānāpavādaḥ / anya evāhanyuṣṇīṣamādadyāttuśabdāt /

praite vadantu pra vayaṃ vadāmetyarbudaḥ / tathaivārṣānukramaṇīdarśanātkādraveyo 'rbudaḥ praita iti / tamarbudaṃ śuddhamavihṛtaṃ vābhiṣṭuyāt / pūrvoktena vihāreṇa saha vikalpaḥ / sa ca yadādhvaryavo nigrābhyāsecanaṃ pūrvaṃ kurvanti triṣvapi savaneṣu tadāpyāyitavatyaḥ pūrvaṃ tato 'rbudaḥ sakalastato mṛṣṭavatyaḥ kalaśavatya iti / devā vā arbudena ca pāvamānībhiścetyaviśeṣaśravaṇāt /

src: mādhyandine stute pavamānena dadhigharmeṇa caranti yadi pravargyavān
tgt: mādhyandinaḥ pavamānaḥ chandogānāṃ prasiddhaḥ / tena stavane kṛte dadhigharmākhyena haviṣā caranti adhvaryavaḥ yadi pravargyavānyajñaḥ /

src: hotar vadasvety ukta uttiṣṭhatāva paśyateti prathamām abhiṣṭauti
tgt: hotarvadasya yatte vādyamityadhvaryuṇā saṃpreṣita uttiṣṭhatāvapaśyatetyetāmabhiṣṭauti /

src: śrātaṃ havir ity ukte dvitīyāṃ sūktasya
tgt: śrātaṃ havirityevamadhvaryuṇokte dvitīyāṃ sūktasya śrātaṃ haviro ṣvindra pāhītyetām / abhiṣṭautītyanuṣajyate / prathamāmabhiṣṭauti dvitīyāṃ sūktasyeti sūktagrahaṇātirekātprathamāgrahaṇātirekācca sarvasvārādiṣvapyetā eva niyamato bhavanti /
dadhigharmasya yajetyevamadhvaryuṇoktastṛtīyayā śrātaṃ manya ūdhanītyetayā yajati /
anavānamardharcānte 'nucchvasannekaikāṃ sapraṇavāmiti pratyṛcaṃ praṇavenāvasyannabhiṣṭauti /
madhye 'navasyanneva /
yajatītyasyānantaramanuvaṣaṭkārasya vacanamāyanigadapratiṣertham /

src: mayi tyad indriyaṃ bṛhan mayi dakṣo mayi kratuḥ / gharmas triśug virocata ākūtyā manasā saha / virājā jyotiṣā saha tasya doham aśīmahi / iti bhakṣamantraḥ
tgt: vaṣaṭkārānuvaṣaṭkārābhyāṃ hutasya dadhigharmadravyaśeṣasya mayi tyadindriyaṃ bṛhadityādiko bhakṣamantraḥ /
savanīyapaśorvapāntaṃ prātaḥsavane kṛtam / athedānīṃ paśupuroḍāśena sviṣṭakṛdiḍena caritvā anantaraṃ puroḍāśaiḥ savanīyairdadhidhānādibhiścaranti /
mādhyandinasya savanasya dhānā iti savanīyapurolāśānāṃ puronuvākyā / praiṣa ukto yājyā ca /
mādhyandine savane jātaveda ityeṣā savanīyahaviḥsviṣṭakṛtaḥ puronuvākyā bhavati / uktā yājyā prātaḥsavane praiṣaśca /
asāvi devaṃ goṛjīkamandha ityevamādikamunnīyamānasūktaṃ bhavati / nāmadheyaṃ prākṛtanivṛttyartham / vāsiṣṭhīrmadhyandina unnīyamānebhyo 'nvāha tā vai daśānvāheti (29.2) śruteḥ /

src: hotā yakṣad indraṃ mādhyandinasya savanasyeti praiṣaḥ
tgt: hotā yakṣadindraṃ mādhyandinasya savanasyetyevamādikaḥ praiṣo bhavati / sunvato yajamānasyetyanayoḥ padayorvikṛtau yathārthamūhaḥ / dviyajamānake sunvatoryajamānayoḥ / bahuyajamānake sunvatāṃ yajamānānāmiti /

src: pibā somam abhi yam ugreti yajati
tgt: pibā somamabhi yamugra tarda iti hotā yajati /
pibā somamityasyaiva sūtasya dvitīyā maitrāvaruṇasya yājyā bhavati /
asyaiva sūktasya /
arvāṅehi somakāmaṃ tvāhuriti potā yajati /
tavāyaṃ somastvamehyarvāṅiti neṣṭuḥ prasthitayājyā bhavati /

src: indrāya somāḥ pradivo vidānā ity acchāvākasya
tgt: indrāya somā ityevamādikācchāvākasya prasthitayājyā /
āpūrṇa asya kalaśaḥ svāhetyāgnīdhrasya prasthitayājyā /
prātaḥsavanāpekṣamuttaratvam /
uttarayoḥ savanayorityetatprakṛtameva /
hotṛcamasapratīkṣaṇaṃ ca sa bhadramakaryo naḥ somaṃ pāyayiṣyatītyevamādikaṃ yadiha noktaṃ tatsamānaṃ tulyaṃ prātaḥsavanena draṣṭavyam /
kramārtho 'nuvādaḥ /
asminkāle prasthitabhakṣānantaraṃ dakṣiṇā dātavyā / sūtrārambhaprayojanaṃ bṛhaspatisave triṣvapi savaneṣveva dakṣiṇākālaḥ /
dvādaśa adhikā yasmiñchate tat dvādaśaṃ śatam / gavāmiti nyāyaprāptasya saṃkhyeyasya sūtraṇaṃ sukhapratipattyartham /
vasantevasante jyotiṣā yajeteti nityatvāt āvaśyakartavyatāyāmasambhave ca dvādaśaśatasya yathopapādaṃ yathāsambhavamekaviṃśatiprabhṛti veti vikalpaḥ /

src: agnaye tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so 'mṛtatvam aśīya / āyur dātra edhi mayo mahyaṃ pratigṛhṇata iti hiraṇyaṃ pratigṛhṇāti
tgt: agnaye tvetyevamādinā mantreṇa hiraṇyaṃ pratigṛhṇāti / nanu godānādhikāre hiraṇyaṃ pratigṛhṇātīti kimarthamucyate / asaṃyujya vidhīyamānaṃ sādhāraṇamiti kathaṃ nāma syāt / ihaiva mā bhūditi nanu dātātra nopātto nāpi pratigrahītāraḥ / āha / nyāyādanyāparebhyaśca vacanebhya eva siddham / yajamāno dātā pratigrahītāraścartvija iti / prativibhajya dānam / patnī ca dadāti viśiṣṭena krameṇetyetacchākhāntarāt /

src: rudrāya tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so 'mṛtatvam aśīya / gaur dātra edhi mayo mahyaṃ paatigṛhṇata iti gāḥ
tgt: rudrāya vetyevamādinā mantreṇa gāḥ pratigṛhṇāti / hotā ca kuryādanādiṣṭamityetadatra nāśrīyate / gavādhikāre hiraṇyapratigrahamantrapāṭhāt /

src: bṛhaspataye tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so 'mṛtatvam aśīya / tvag dātra edhi mayo mahyaṃ pratigṛhṇata iti vāsaḥ
tgt: bṛhaspataya ityevamādinā mantreṇa vāsaḥ pratigṛhṇāti / <7.18.4 4. yamāya tvetyevamādinā mantreṇaikaśaphaṃ pratigṛhṇāti / ekaśaphamityaśvo 'śvarī gardabha iti prasiddhaḥ / <7.18.5 5. anyanmanthaudanatilamāṣādikaṃ prajāpataya ityevamādinā mantreṇa pratigṛhṇāti /
omityanena vā mantreṇa sarvaṃ pratigṛhṇāti / vā pūrvairagnaye tvetyevamādikairmantraiḥ /

src: ko 'dāt kasmā adād ity anumantrayate prāṇi
tgt: ko 'dādityevamādikena mantreṇānumantrayate yatprāṇi /
ko 'dādityevamādinā mantreṇopaspṛśeditaradaprāṇi /

src: asmadrātā madhumatīr devatrā gacchata pradātāram ā viśata iti dattvā japati
tgt: asmadrātā ityevamādikaṃ mantraṃ yajamāno japati / patnī cāviśeṣāddakṣiṇāṃ dattvā / dātāramityasya vikāre 'pyanūhaḥ svātmanirdeśāt /
indrāya marutvate 'nubrūhītyadhvaryuṇā saṃpreṣito marutvatīyagrahayāgārtham / tasya kathaṃ pradānaṃ bhavatītyata āha /
indra marutva iha pāhi somamiti puronuvākyā bhavati /

src: hotā yakṣad indraṃ marutvantam iti praiṣaḥ
tgt: hotā yakṣadindraṃ marutvantamityādikaḥ praiṣo bhavati /
sajoṣā indra sagaṇo marudbhirityanayā yajati / evamayaṃ sapraiṣapradānaḥ /
keṣāṃcidadhvaryūṇāmatra grahāntarasyānuhomo 'sti / taccheṣabhavanivṛttyarthaṃ tamiti nirdeśaḥ / bhakṣayitveti ktvāpratyayaḥ kramārthaḥ / marutvatīyamiti saṃjñānirdeśaḥ śāstrasaṃvyavahārārthaḥ /

src: adhvaryo śoṃśāvo3 ity āhāvaḥ śastrādau mādhyandine savane
tgt: adhvaryo śoṃsāvo3 ityevamāhāvaḥ śastraprārambhe sarvatra prāyaścittārtheṣvapi śastreṣu mādhyandine savane /
prātaḥsavane bhavaḥ prātaḥsavanikaḥ śoṃsāvī3 iti ya uktaḥ sa mādhyandine savane śastramadhye bhavati /

src: ā tvā rathaṃ yathotaya iti prātipadaṃ tṛcaṃ śastvāhūya
tgt: ā tvā rathaṃ yathotaya ityevamādikaṃ tṛcaṃ śastvāhūya / prātipadamiti śastraprārambhaṇamityarthaḥ / saṃjñākaraṇaṃ śāstrasaṃvyavahārārtham /

src: idaṃ vaso sutam andha ity anucaraṃ tṛcaṃ śastvāhūya
tgt: anucaramiti saṃjñākaraṇaṃ śāstrasaṃvyavahārārtham /

src: indra nedīya ed ihītīndranihavaṃ pragāthaṃ śastvāhūya
tgt: indranihavaṃ pragāthamiti saṃjñānirdeśaḥ svaśāstropayogī /

src: pra nūnaṃ brahmaṇaspatir iti brāhmaṇaspatyaṃ pragāthaṃ śastvāhūya
tgt: brāhmaṇaspatyamiti saṃjñākaraṇamuktārtham /
agnirnetā bhaga iva kṣitīnāmityekāṃ śastvāhūya / ekāvacanaṃ dvṛcanivṛttyarthaṃ ekapātinīsaṃjñārthaṃ cottarayorapi /
rathantaramiti sāmno nāmadheyam / tannikevalyasya śastrasya stotraṃ bhavati / ārambhaprayojanaṃ yonyanuśaṃsanam /
bṛhadvā pṛṣṭhaṃ niṣkevalyasya stotraṃ bhavati /

src: abhi tvā śūrābhi tvā pūrvapītaya iti stotriyānurūpau pragāthau rathantarasya
tgt: abhi tvā śūra nonumaḥ / abhi tvā pūrvapītaya iti stotriyānurūpau yathāsaṅkhyena / prathamaḥ stotriyo dvitīyo anurūpa iti / rathantarasyetyanuśaṃsanasaṃbandhena ṣaṣṭhī /

src: tvām iddhi havāmahe tvaṃ hy ehi cerava iti bṛhataḥ
tgt: stotriyānurūpau pragāthāviti vartate / pragāthagrahaṇaṃ sarvatra dharmaviśeṣapratipādanārtham /
yadvāvāna puratamaṃ purāṣāḍiti dhāyyā / asaṃyogavihitatvādubhayatra / dhāyyeti saṃjñā śāstrasaṃvyavahārārthā /

src: pibā sutasya rasina iti pragātho rathantarasya
tgt: iha pragāthagrahaṇaṃ dvṛcārtham /
ubhayaṃ śṛṇavacca na iti bṛhatpakṣe bṛhatsāmnaḥ pragātho bhavati /
indrasya nu vīryāṇi ma vocamityetatsūktaṃ rathantarapṛṣṭhe sati bhavati /
tamu ṣṭuhi yo abhibhūtyojā iti bṛhatpṛṣṭhe sati sūktaṃ bhavati /
nīcaistarāmityarthaḥ /

src: ukthavīryaṃ japitvā pibā somam indra mandatu tveti yajati
tgt: sūktasyāṣṭāvṛcaḥ śastvendro devaḥ somaṃ pibatvityādikā nividbhavati / dvitīyā niṣkevalyasyeti vacanāt / tasyā nivido 'nantaramāmnāyapāṭhe samrāḍasītyevamādikaṃ tadiha japatvena coditam /
ubhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī yasya sa ubhayasāmā somaḥ / sa eva kenacitpratyakṣādinā viśeṣeṇa rathantaraṣpṛṣṭho bṛhatpṛṣṭho vābhidhīyate / tatra tāvadrathantarapṛṣṭhe yo viśeṣaḥ sa ucyate /

src: rathantarapṛṣṭhe yaḥ sūktāt pūrvaḥ pragāthas tam uddhṛtya bṛhato yoniṃ śaṃsati
tgt: yaḥ sūtātpūrvaḥ pragātha uktaḥ pibā sutasya rasina ityevamādistamapanīya tasminneva sthāne bṛhato yoniṃ śaṃsati / tvāmiddhi havāmaha iti yadadhyūḍhaṃ sāma gīyate sā tasya sāmno yonirityucyate /

kvacitpradeśaviśeṣe bṛhati gīyamāne bṛhatpṛṣṭhaḥ soma ityucyate / tatra bṛhṛtpṛṣṭhe yaḥ sūtātpūrvaḥ pragātha ubhayaṃ śṛṇavacca na ityevamādikastamuddhṛtyābhi tvā śūra nonuma ityevamādikāṃ rathantarasya yoniṃ śaṃsati /
yadetadyonyanuśaṃsanamuktametaduttarāsu saṃsthāsu / prākṛtāmagniṣṭomasaṃsthāṃ muktvā / anyāsu sāmapragāthādūrdhvaṃ bhavati / sāmapragātho notsṛjyata ityarthaḥ /
yadetaduktaṃ sāmapragāthamuddhṛtyānuddhṛtya vā rathantarādeḥ śaṃsanametadyonyanuśaṃsanamityācakṣate yājñikāḥ /

src: bṛhadrathantarayor evānuśaṃsed iti ha smāha kauṣītakiḥ
tgt: bṛhadrathantarayoreva yonimanuśaṃsenānyatretyevamāha kauṣītakiḥ / kauṣītakigrahaṇaṃ vikalpārtham / iti ha smāhetyatiriktavacanādayamevābhīṣṭaḥ pakṣaḥ sūtrakārasya iti jñāyate / tathā ca śrutiḥ yatratu kva caite sāmanī ityārabhyāmnātaiva /

parimitaṃ śasyamasminprākṛte 'gniṣṭome / so 'yamevaṃrūpaḥ / pragāthe śasyamāne yonyāṃ cātiricyate / tasmātpragāthamuddharati / parimitaśasyatā śrautā / sa vā eṣo 'gniṣṭoma ājyaprabhṛtyāgnimārutānto yacchasyaṃ trīṇi ṣaṣṭiśatānyṛcāṃ saṃpadyata iti (kau0 bra0 16.8) / sā na śakyate bādhitum / tasmātpragāthamuddharati /

src: stotriyāyāhāvo 'nurūpāya dhāyyāyai pragāthāya sūktāya nivide paridhānīyāyai ca
tgt: tādarthyāya caturthyā nirdeśādāhāvena mahāvṛttirnāśe siddhā bhavati /
prakaraṇānniṣkevalyanividi śastāyāṃ hotre varo deyaḥ / sa cāśvaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ / varo vā / gaurityarthaḥ /
vāmadevākhyaṃ sāma maitrāvaruṇaśastrasya stotraṃ bhavati /

src: kayā naś citraḥ kayā tvaṃ na ūtyeti stotriyānurūpau
tgt: kayā naścitra ā bhuvaditi stotriyaḥ / kayā tvaṃ na ūtyetyanurūpaḥ /
kastamindra tvāvasumiti sāmnaḥ pragātho bhavati /
sadyo ha jāto vṛṣabhaḥ kanīna ityetatsūktaṃ sāmapragāthādanantaramāhūya śaṃset /
dvitīyametatsūktaṃ maitrāvaruṇasya /

src: uśan nu ṣu ṇa iti yajati
tgt: uśannu ṣu ṇaḥ sumanā upāke yājyāmetāṃ karoti /
naudhasamiti sāma / tadbrāhmaṇacchaṃsinaḥ śastrasya rathantarapṛṣṭhe some sati stotraṃ bhavati /
bṛhatpṛṣṭhe some śyetaṃ sāma brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ stotraṃ bhavati / tatsaṃbandhena śastravyavahārārthaṃ chāndogyamapyuktam /

src: taṃ vo dasmaṃ tat tvā yāmi suvīryam iti stotriyānurūpau pragāthau naudhasasya
tgt: taṃ vo dasmamṛtīṣaham / tattvā yāmi suvīryamityetau pragāthau stotriyānurūpau pragrathanadharmaviśiṣṭau naudhamasya sāmno bhavataḥ /

src: abhi pra vaḥ pra su śrutam iti śyaitasya
tgt: abhi pra vaḥ surādhasam / pra su śrutaṃ surādhasamityetau stotriyānurūpau pragrathanadharmaviśiṣṭau śyetasya sāmno bhavataḥ /

src: ud u tye madhumattamā iti sāmapragāthaḥ
tgt: ubhayoḥ śyaitanaudhasayorasaṃyogavidhānāt /
indraḥ pūrbhidātiraddāsamarkairityetatsūktaṃ naudhase sāmni sati bhavati /
asāvi somaḥ puruhūta tubhyamityetatsūktaṃ śyaite sāmni sati bhavati /
udu brahmāyairata śravasyetyetatsūktaṃ samānam / sāmāntareṣvapi vacanādṛte noddhartavyamityabhiprāyaḥ /
ṛjīṣau vajrī vṛṣabhasturāṣāḍityetayā yajati /
kāleyākhyaṃ sāmācchāvākaśastrasya stotraṃ bhavati / tasminsati śastramucyate /

src: tarobhir vas taraṇir it siṣāsatīti stotriyānurūpau pragāthau
tgt: tarobhirvo vidadvasum / taraṇiritsiṣāsatīti stotriyānurūpau pragrathanadharmaviśiṣṭau /

src: ud inv asya ricyata iti sāmapragāthaḥ
tgt: udinvasyetyevamādiko dvṛcaḥ sāmapragāthaḥ kāryaḥ / <7.24.4 4. bhūya idvāvṛdhe vīryāyetyetatsūktaṃ śaṃset /
imāmū ṣu prabhṛtiṃ sātaye dhā ityetat dvitīyaṃ sūktaṃ śaṃset /
pibā vardhasva tava ghā sutāsa ityetayā yajati /
ita uttaraṃ yadvakṣyāmastacchastreṣu bhavatīti veditavyam /
prāyeṇa bāhulyena ayathāsamāmnātaṃ yadṛgjātaṃ bhavati taducyate /

src: bṛhatī pūrvā kakub vā satobṛhaty uttarā taṃ pragātha ity ācakṣate
tgt: bṛhatī ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā sā pūrvāmnāyakrameṇa / kakubvāmnāyakrameṇa pūrvasthā madhyamena dvādaśākṣareṇāṣṭāviṃśatyakṣarā / satobṛhatyuttarā / satobṛhatī catvāriṃśadakṣarā / yasyāḥ prathamatṛtīyau dvādaśākṣarau dvitīyacaturthāvaṣṭākṣarau sā cedbṛhatyāḥ kakubho vāmnāyakrameṇottarā tamevaṃrūpaṃ dvṛcaṃ pragātha ityācakṣate yājñikā nānyam /
bārhataḥ pragātha ityucyate / bṛhatyāṃ pūrvasyāṃ satyām / purastādbṛhatyādivikārarūpāyāmapi satobṛhatyāmuttarasyāmiti sthitam /
kākubhaḥ pragātho bhavati kakubhi pūrvasyāṃ satobṛhatyāṃ tūttarasyāṃ viparītādivikṛtāyāmapi /

src: bṛhatīṃ śastvottamaṃ pādaṃ pratyādāyottarasyāḥ prathamenāvasāya dvitīyena praṇutya taṃ pratyādāya tṛtīyenāvasāyottamena praṇauti
tgt: bṛhatīṃ sakalāṃ śastvā tasyā evottamaṃ pādaṃ pratyādāya punaḥ śastvetyarthaḥ /

src: tās tisro bhavanti bṛhatī pūrvottare kakubhau
tgt: uttarasyā ṛcaḥ prathamena pādena saha saṃdhānaṃ kṛtvāvasāya /
sarvatra pṛṣṭhanirapekṣo yajñāyajñīyasyāyaṃ kakupkāradharmaḥ / <7.25.11 15. indranihavasaṃjñakasya brāhmaṇaspatyasaṃjñakānāṃ ca sarvatrāyaṃ kakupkāradharmaḥ /
ata uktebhyo 'nyatra bārhatānāṃ pragāthānāṃ dharma ucyate /

src: bṛhatīṃ śastvottamaṃ pādaṃ dviḥ pratyādāyāvasāyārdharcenottarasyāḥ praṇutya dvitīyaṃ pādaṃ dviḥ pratyādāyāvasāyottamenārdharcena praṇauti
tgt: bṛhatīṃ sakalāṃ śastvā uttamaṃ pādaṃ dviḥ pratyādāyānte 'vasāya / 18. uttarasyā ṛco 'rdharcānte praṇavaṃ kṛtvā / 19. yasminpraṇavaḥ kṛtastameva dvitīyaṃ pādaṃ dviḥ pratyādāya tadante 'vasāyottamena pragāthasyārdharcena praṇauti /
evaṃ kriyamāṇā bhavantītyarthaḥ / 21. kākubhe pragāthe dharmaviśeṣa ucyate / kakubhaṃ śastvā tasyā evottamaṃ pādaṃ pratyādatte / tamādāya satobṛhatyāḥ prathamena pādenāvasāya dvitīyena praṇauti /
pratyādatta iti vartate / satobṛhatyā dvitīyaṃ pratyādatte / taṃ pratyādāya tṛtīyenāvasāyottamena praṇauti /
evaṃ kriyamāṇāḥ kākubhāḥ pragāthāstisraḥ kakubho bhavanti /

src: stotriyatvād anurūpatvād vā / etaṃ dharmaṃ pragāthā labhante
tgt: stotriyatvātkāraṇādanurūpatvādvā etamuktaṃ pragrathamadharmaṃ pragāthā labhante / na tu punaḥ pragāthatvenaiva kāraṇena / tataḥ sāmāntarukthye yonyanuśaṃsanādau ca na pragrathanam /
indra nedīya edihītyayamindranihavaḥ pragāthaḥ / stotriyatvaṃ vināpi pragrathanadharmaṃ labhate /
stotriyānurūpatvarahitā api pra nūnaṃ brahmaṇaspatiruttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate praitu brahmaṇaspatirityete brāhmaṇaspatyāḥ kakupkāradharmāḥ /

src: dvābhyām avasāya dvābhyām avasāyaikena praṇauti paṅktīnām
tgt: dvābhyāṃdvābhyāṃ pādābhyāmavasāyāvasāya pañcamena praṇavaḥ / iti paṅktīnāṃ śasyadharmaḥ /

etāsāṃ yathopadiṣṭānāṃ pacchaḥśaṃsanaṃ śasyadharmaḥ / akṣarapaṅktayo nirjñātasvarūpā dvipadāśca / tatastayorasamāsanirdeśaḥ / triṣṭubjagatyostu cchandovicityāmanekavikārakriyāviśiṣṭayorlakṣaṇapāṭhāt tadīyavikāropasaṃgrahārthaḥ samāmanirdeśaḥ / na tu ṣaṭpadānāṃ yatnāntarāt / atijagatyo 'pi jagatya eva / prahastake śastrasya tulyanyāyatvāt /
prāyaṇīyayā udayanīyā tulyetyarthaḥ /
yāḥ prāyaṇīyāyāṃ puronuvākyāstā udayanīyāyāṃ yājyāḥ karoti yā yājyāstāḥ puronuvākyā iti (7 - 8) śruteḥ /
ayaṃ codayanīyāyāṃ viśeṣaḥ /
agniṃ prathamamudayanīye yajatyatha somamatha savitāramatha pathyāṃ svastimathāditimiti śrutau yāgakramaniyamāt /
udayanīyāyā anantaraṃ mitrāvaruṇadevatākā vaśā bandhyā gauranubandhyākhyā kartavyā /
payasyā vā maitrāvaruṇī bhavati / na gaurevānūbandhyeti / evaṃ nu yadi paśuranūbandhyā bhavati yadyu vai payasyeti (18.12) śrutatvāt /

src: ā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā tat su vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā no mitrāvaruṇeti puronuvākyāḥ
tgt: ā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā havyajuṣṭimiti vapāyāḥ / tatsu vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā mahitvamiti purolāśasya / ā no mitrāvaruṇā havyajuṣṭimiti haviṣaḥ / aprathamāpi triṣṭupprāyāt /

src: yuvaṃ vastrāṇi yad banhiṣṭhaṃ pra bāhaveti yājyāḥ
tgt: yuvaṃ vastrāṇi pīvasā vasāthe iti vapāyai yājyeti śruteḥ / yadbaṃhiṣṭaṃ nātividhe sudānū iti purolāśasyeti śruteḥ / pra bāhavā sisṛtaṃ jīvase na iti haviṣa iti (18.13) śruteḥ /

src: dīkṣaṇīyāprabhṛtyānubandhyāyāḥ saṃsthānān na vede patnīṃ vācayati na stṛṇāti
tgt: dīkṣaṇīyāta ārabhya yāvadanubandhyāsamāptiḥ tāvaddarśapūrṇamāsavikāreṣu karmasu na vede patna vācayati na ca vedaṃ stṛṇāti /
staraṇapradeśaviśeṣārthaḥ sūtrārambhaḥ /

src: māpo mauṣadhīr hiṃsīḥ śug asi yaṃ dviṣmas taṃ te śug ṛcchatu / dhāmnodhāmno rājaṃs tato varuṇa no muñca / yadāpo 'ghnyā iti varuṇeti śapāmahe tato varuṇa no muñca / iti hṛdayaśūlam upasthāya sumitriyā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santv ity upaspṛśya durmitriyās tasmai santu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣma iti dakṣiṇā nirukṣanti
tgt: māpo mauṣadhīrityevamādinā mantreṇa hṛdayaśūlopasthānaṃ kuryāt / hiṃsiṣṭaṃ śucau stha iti dvayoḥ satoḥ / hiṃsiṣṭa śucaḥ stha iti bahuṣu / taṃ vāṃ śucāvṛcchatām / taṃ vaḥ śuca ṛcchantu / evaṃ yathārthamūhaḥ /
sumitriyā na ityevamādinā mantreṇāpa upaspṛśya tataḥ /
durmitriyā ityevamādinā mantreṇa tā apo dakṣiṇā kṣipanti paśukartāraḥ /
vāśabdātsakalāṅgakalāpā vā /
